name: Fenlow Station 122 EGEO
description: Key Features High Airflow Capacity: Supports an airflow rate of 11,403 cubic metres per hour, making it ideal for large-scale ventilation and filtration systems. Efficient Filtration: Rated at 42 micrometres (μm) particle filtration, effectively capturing dust, spores, and other airborne contaminants for improved air quality. Low Pressure Drop: Engineered for a pressure drop of just 120 pascals, ensuring energy-efficient operation and reducing strain on air handling units. Durable Pleated Fibre Medium: Utilizes a pleated fibre filter medium, maximizing surface area for extended filtration performance and longer service life. Long Service Interval: Designed for a service interval of up to 3,219 hours, minimizing maintenance frequency and operational downtime. Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on project requirements. Main Benefits Enhanced Air Purity: Effectively removes particles as small as 42 μm, supporting healthier indoor environments in commercial, industrial, or laboratory settings. Cost-Effective Operation: The low pressure drop and long service interval contribute to reduced energy consumption and lower maintenance costs. Reliable Performance: The robust pleated fibre construction ensures consistent filtration efficiency and durability, even under continuous use. Adaptable Integration: Compatible with a wide range of HVAC and air filtration systems requiring high airflow and medium particulate filtration. Typical Use Cases and Outcomes Industrial Air Filtration: Suited for manufacturing plants, warehouses, and processing facilities needing reliable airborne particulate removal. Commercial HVAC Systems: Enhances indoor air quality in office buildings, shopping centres, and public spaces by trapping dust and allergens. Laboratory and Cleanroom Applications: Maintains controlled environments by filtering out contaminants to protect sensitive equipment and processes. Maintenance Optimization: Ideal for users seeking filters with extended service intervals to reduce the frequency of replacements and associated labor costs. Frequently Asked User Questions Is this filter durable and easy to maintain? Yes, the pleated fibre medium offers durability and a long service interval, making it easy to maintain and cost-effective over time. Will this filter fit my current system? The filter is designed for compatibility with systems requiring high airflow and a 42 μm filtration rating. Please check your system specifications for compatibility. How does the filter help reduce operational costs? The low pressure drop minimizes energy consumption, while the extended service interval reduces maintenance needs, both contributing to overall cost savings.
description_html:
Key Features

  • High Airflow Capacity: Supports an airflow rate of 11,403 cubic metres per hour, making it ideal for large-scale ventilation and filtration systems.
  • Efficient Filtration: Rated at 42 micrometres (μm) particle filtration, effectively capturing dust, spores, and other airborne contaminants for improved air quality.
  • Low Pressure Drop: Engineered for a pressure drop of just 120 pascals, ensuring energy-efficient operation and reducing strain on air handling units.
  • Durable Pleated Fibre Medium: Utilizes a pleated fibre filter medium, maximizing surface area for extended filtration performance and longer service life.
  • Long Service Interval: Designed for a service interval of up to 3,219 hours, minimizing maintenance frequency and operational downtime.
  • Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Enhanced Air Purity: Effectively removes particles as small as 42 μm, supporting healthier indoor environments in commercial, industrial, or laboratory settings.
  • Cost-Effective Operation: The low pressure drop and long service interval contribute to reduced energy consumption and lower maintenance costs.
  • Reliable Performance: The robust pleated fibre construction ensures consistent filtration efficiency and durability, even under continuous use.
  • Adaptable Integration: Compatible with a wide range of HVAC and air filtration systems requiring high airflow and medium particulate filtration.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Industrial Air Filtration: Suited for manufacturing plants, warehouses, and processing facilities needing reliable airborne particulate removal.
  • Commercial HVAC Systems: Enhances indoor air quality in office buildings, shopping centres, and public spaces by trapping dust and allergens.
  • Laboratory and Cleanroom Applications: Maintains controlled environments by filtering out contaminants to protect sensitive equipment and processes.
  • Maintenance Optimization: Ideal for users seeking filters with extended service intervals to reduce the frequency of replacements and associated labor costs.

Frequently Asked User Questions

  • Is this filter durable and easy to maintain?
    Yes, the pleated fibre medium offers durability and a long service interval, making it easy to maintain and cost-effective over time.

  • Will this filter fit my current system?
    The filter is designed for compatibility with systems requiring high airflow and a 42 μm filtration rating. Please check your system specifications for compatibility.

  • How does the filter help reduce operational costs?
    The low pressure drop minimizes energy consumption, while the extended service interval reduces maintenance needs, both contributing to overall cost savings.
